github.note: Use gh CLI directly, no MCP needed. Install: brew install gh && gh auth login

gmail.note: Use Claude.ai built-in Gmail MCP or manual export. No local MCP server needed.

google-calendar.note: Use Claude.ai built-in Google Calendar MCP. No local MCP server needed.

rule: Do not copy this file into a client config with real secrets. Secrets stay outside the vault and outside git. Connect one server at a time. Test with one read-only operation before bulk use.
